target_path.description: The directory or URL to open and scan by default.

window_title.description: A descriptive name for the wrapper script context.

display.description: Switches displays on X11 (hostname:screen_number). Overrides DISPLAY env var.

platformtheme.description: Specifies the Qt Platform Theme (e.g., kde, gtk). Overridden by QT_QPA_PLATFORMTHEME.

platformpluginpath.description: Specifies the path to Qt platform plugins. Overridden by QT_QPA_PLATFORM_PLUGIN_PATH.

qwindowtitle.description: Sets the title of the first window using the -qwindowtitle argument.

qwindowgeometry.description: Specifies window geometry for the main window using X11 syntax (e.g., 100x100+50+50).

plugin.description: Additional Qt plugins to load. May appear multiple times.
